scope: Cloud Calendars competitor discovery and useful keyword-intent articles. Preserve distinction between observed query results, publisher features and actual ranking exports.
methodLimits: Google samples use hl=en gl=us pws=0; physical market and signed-in account are not a controlled international rank panel.
Google result headings that mention a product are not automatically a ranking of its owned domain.
Related strings include navigation, filters and shopping artifacts; 307 strings are not 307 independent keywords with measured demand.
ChatGPT has 14 unseeded discovery prompts and one seeded comparison. Account personalization and model version are uncontrolled. No stable recommendation-share claim.
Official help establishes publisher-documented capabilities, not hands-on performance or privacy verification.
Own-site Search Console covers available queries for our site, not competitor keywords. Period ends before these publication increments.
English articles indexable; translated articles and translated hubs remain noindex pending individual approval.
remainingRequiredEvidence: An existing competitor organic-keyword export or authenticated research-tool data is needed for substantially more complete query/rank inventories. User asked which existing tool is available; no credentials requested.
No public inspection can prove literally all competitors’ Google keywords or all prompts in ChatGPT. Do not call this exhaustive.

unavailableDetail.finding: Brand result observed; selected Apple detail page returned not found. No unverified product feature claims or global delisting claim.

contentPolicy: One substantive page per distinct intent. Same-intent variants mapped to an existing canonical; unsupported/platform-mismatched/navigation-only fragments do not justify thin pages.

currentIncrement.reason: Close source-verifiable Watch, iPad and rain-amount gaps without duplicate numeric or brand pages.
